Mirage dragons are masters of illusion magic and use their powers to deceive others and further their own agendas. In addition to their magical prowess, mirage dragons possess a number of additional features to help them on hunts or mislead attackers, such as their camouflaging scales and a hallucinatory breath that can confound multiple foes at once. Mirage dragons are vain and egotistical figures. They ultimately care more about themselves than others. **[Recall Knowledge - Dragon](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35)): DC 40 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 38 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35 [Ancient Mirage Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2952) **Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 123 **Perception** +33; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), illusion sense, [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Shadowtongue](/Languages.aspx?ID=21) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +33, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +32, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +34, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +32, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +37, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +35, [Illusion Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +34, [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) +35, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +35, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +33 **Str** +7 **Dex** +7 **Con** +6 **Int** +6 **Wis** +7 **Cha** +9 **Camouflage** The dragon can [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) in natural environments even if they don't have [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=459).
**Illusion Sense** When the dragon moves within 30 feet of an [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629) that can be disbelieved, they automatically attempt a [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=690) check to disbelieve, even if they didn't spend an action to Interact. --- **AC** 41 **Fort** +28 **Ref** +29 **Will** +33 +2 status to all saves vs. [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534) **HP** 345 **Immunities** [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696) **Scintillating Defense** ([visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Trigger** The dragon is targeted with an attack; **Effect** The dragon flashes their iridescent scales at the triggering creature to throw off the attack. The dragon gains [concealment](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62)against the triggering attack. --- **Speed** 60 feet, climb 40 feet, fly 180 feet **Melee** jaws +33 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d10+15 piercing **Melee** claws +33 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d6+15 slashing **Melee** tail +31 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d8+15 bludgeoning **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 43 - **Cantrips (9th)** [Figment](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528), [Message](/Spells.aspx?ID=190) - **4th** [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (at will) - **8th** [Illusory Creature](/Spells.aspx?ID=158), [Illusory Object](/Spells.aspx?ID=160) (at will), [Illusory Scene](/Spells.aspx?ID=161) (at will), [Mirage](/Spells.aspx?ID=1604), [Vibrant Pattern](/Spells.aspx?ID=357) **Captivating Display** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) **Frequency** once per 10 minutes; **Effect** The dragon opens the fins on their head, creating a radiant display of enthralling colors. Each creature in a 30-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 41 Will save or be [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) and [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) (or slowed 2 on a critical failure) for 1 round. Regardless of the result, a creature is then temporarily immune to Captivating Display for 1 minute. **Draconic Frenzy** The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order. **Draconic Momentum** The dragon recharges their Hallucinatory Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike. **Hallucinatory Breath** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The dragon breathes a cloud that assaults the senses and deals 17d6 mental damage in a 50-foot cone (DC 41 Will save). A creature that fails its save is also [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63) for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure) and is then temporarily immune to being confused by Hallucinatory Breath for 1 hour. The dragon can't use Hallucinatory Breath again for 1d4 rounds. **Lunging Bite** The dragon lunges their head forward, making a jaws Strike with an extended reach of 25 feet. **[Sneak Attack](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=34)** The dragon's Strikes deal an additional 3d6 precision damage to [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) targets.
name: Ancient Mirage Dragon
